# Travel and Expense Policy v7 (Current)

**Policy code:** FIN-EXP-07
**Effective:** 1 April 2026
**Supersedes:** Travel and Expense Policy v6 (FIN-EXP-06), retired 31 March 2026
**Owner:** Dolores Achterberg, Controller
**Classification:** Internal — Finance

## 1. Per diem allowances

| Travel type | Allowance |
| --- | --- |
| Domestic (same country as home office) | **$63 per day** |
| International | **$91 per day** |
| Same-day travel under 8 hours | Not eligible |

Per diem covers meals and incidental expenses only. Lodging is reimbursed
against actual receipts.

## 2. Pre-approval threshold

Any single expense item **above $2,400** requires written pre-approval from a
cost-centre owner before the spend is committed. Items at or below $2,400 may
be submitted after the fact.

Splitting a single purchase into multiple sub-$2,400 line items to avoid
pre-approval is a policy violation and is flagged automatically by the
reconciliation job.

## 3. Receipt submission window

Receipts must be submitted within **21 calendar days** of the transaction date.
Submissions after 21 days require a written exception from the Controller and
are reimbursed at the discretion of Finance.

## 4. Mileage

Personal vehicle mileage is reimbursed at **$0.58 per mile**. Mileage claims
must include origin, destination and business purpose.

## 5. Non-reimbursable items

- In-flight wifi above $35 per segment
- Hotel minibar
- Traffic and parking fines
- Personal travel insurance
- Airline seat upgrades on flights under 4 hours

## 6. Exceptions

Exception requests go to `finance-exceptions@` with the cost-centre owner
copied. The Controller reviews exceptions weekly on Thursdays.
